messages:
alice: Kicking off RC rc-2026.03.22-C (sha: c3f9d2). Change window 19:30-20:30 UTC. Need signoffs: keystore rotation, KV prefix warm, smoke checks, release-note callouts. Will pin before promo. @marc can you run KV warm on prod-shadow? @dana please sanity-check release notes and QA list.

marc: KV warm started on prod-shadow. warmed=36 shards, hit_rate=0.90, mem=72%. saw two transient retries during warm, retried automatically. Log snippet:
```
2026-03-22T17:12:14Z kv-warm: warmed=36 hit_rate=0.90 transient_retries=2 mem=72%
```
No OOMs.

dana: Release notes updated with "logits scaling tweak" warning and migration hint. QA smoke checklist ready (100 token diffs, e2e proxy, latency gates). +1.

alice: Keystore rotated to kms-prod-09, decryption probe ok, secret v5 in vault. Pinning now.

deploy-bot: /pin rc-2026.03.22-C -> pin_id=pin-2301, artifact=c3f9d2, pinned_by=alice at 3832100018

alice: Starting canary: /promote rc-2026.03.22-C --to canary --percent 5 --duration 15m --pin

deploy-bot: Canary job job-2302 started. Logs: https://ci.internal/jobs/2302/logs

qa-bot: Canary smoke finished: token_checks 99/100 (one formatting edge case), error_rate delta +0.02% (ok), p95 latency +6% (ok). Recommend 3-stage staged-promote 20->60->100 with a 5m guard after stage2.

ops-oncall: I'll hold sheriff. Set alert thresholds: errors +0.5% abs, latency +25% p95.

alice: Initiating staged promote: /promote rc-2026.03.22-C --to prod --staged --stages 20,60,100 --pin

deploy-bot: Stage 1 -> 20% applied at 3832100026.

deploy-bot: Stage 2 -> 60% applied at 3832100030.

ops-oncall: Observability shows a small spike in upstream retries in one region at stage2. Upstream team notified; ETA for backoff bump ~7m. Holding before final stage.

(7m)

ops-oncall: Upstream backoff bump deployed. Telemetry cleared. Proceeding to final stage.

deploy-bot: Stage 3 -> 100% applied. Promotion complete. rc-2026.03.22-C live in prod. :tada:

alice: Post-deploy: running 30m post-checks. Rollback quick commands if needed:
```
# revert to previous stable RC
/promote rc-2026.02.25-078 --to prod --pin --force
# kubernetes fallback
kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/llm-service --to-revision=2059
# emergency feature gate off
curl -X POST https://feature-gate.prod/flags/llm-service -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" -d '{"enabled":false}'
```

qa-bot: 10m into post-checks, no alerts. Will update release notes with canary summary and close when window clears.
